text: {"lessons":["I should not let my purchase price or reluctance to admit a mistake decide whether I hold or sell; I should assess each position on its future prospects and portfolio role.","Selling Stock B and Stock E at a gain felt rewarding, but that feeling alone is not a sound reason to sell; I should avoid favoring realized gains over equally sensible loss-taking or holding decisions.","Monthly swings have not given me a reliable signal about what comes next, so I should follow a diversified plan and avoid reacting to short-term noise."]}
